supporting_quotes.exact: The API models the camera subsystem as a pipeline that converts incoming requests for frame captures into frames, on a 1:1 basis.

observations.subject: The API
observations.object: the camera subsystem as a pipeline that converts requests for frame captures into frames

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,129)（evidence-fe448cb00526，aosp-camera-hal3）：'The API models the camera subsystem as a pipeline that converts incoming requests for frame captures into frames, on a 1:1 basis.' 直接支持 claim 的'流水线'建模与'capture request 按 1:1 转换为一个 frame'两个命题；来源为 Camera HAL3 API 文档，'The API'即指向 Camera HAL3。verdict: supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: Starting with Android 13, camera HAL interface development uses AIDL. Android 8.0 introduced Treble, switching the Camera HAL API to a stable interface defined by the HAL interface description language (HIDL).

observations.subject: camera HAL interface development
observations.object: AIDL from Android 13; Android 8.0 Treble switched the Camera HAL API to a stable HIDL-defined interface

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,209)（evidence-cf017f340ff1，aosp-camera-hal3）主干：'Starting with Android 13, camera HAL interface development uses AIDL. Android 8.0 introduced Treble, switching the Camera HAL API to a stable interface defined by the HAL interface description language (HIDL).' 与 claim 的两条时间线事实逐项一致（Android 8.0 引入 Treble 并切换到 HIDL 稳定接口；自 Android 13 起开发改用 AIDL），claim 仅改变语序。verdict: supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: The HAL sits between the camera driver and the higher-level Android framework and defines an interface that you must implement so apps can correctly operate the camera hardware.
Android's camera hardware abstraction layer (HAL) connects the higher-level camera framework APIs in Camera 2 to your underlying camera driver and hardware.

observations.subject: The HAL
observations.object: between the camera driver and the higher-level Android framework; defines an interface that must be implemented so apps can operate the camera hardware

observations.subject: Android's camera HAL
observations.object: the higher-level camera framework APIs in Camera 2 to the underlying camera driver and hardware

claims.rationale: 两条引文同源（aosp-camera-architecture）。evidence-d937f440c251 [0,177) 支持'位于 camera driver 与更高层 framework 之间'及'定义必须实现以让应用正确操作相机硬件的接口'；evidence-8a33cfacf842 [0,156) 支持'向上连接 Camera 2 框架 API'。两条引文共同完整覆盖 claim 三要素，无冲突。两 target provenance 均为空且同源，无法举证独立性（independence_unknown），属同一来源的多重表述而非独立佐证。verdict: supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: Android 9 introduced API support for multi-camera devices through a new logical camera device composed of two or more physical camera devices pointing in the same direction. The logical camera device is exposed as a single CameraDevice/CaptureSession to an app allowing for interaction with HAL-integrated multi-camera features.

observations.subject: logical camera device
observations.object: Android 9, composed of two or more physical camera devices pointing in the same direction, exposed as a single CameraDevice/CaptureSession

qualifiers.composition: two or more physical devices, same direction

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,328)（evidence-260cce4b839f，aosp-camera-multi-camera）：'Android 9 introduced API support... a new logical camera device composed of two or more physical camera devices pointing in the same direction... exposed as a single CameraDevice/CaptureSession to an app' 逐项对应 claim 的 Android 9 引入、两个及以上同向物理设备组成、对应用呈现为单个 CameraDevice/CaptureSession。verdict: supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: Most of this information is a static property of the camera subsystem and can therefore be queried before configuring any output pipelines or submitting any requests.

the new camera API adds a substantial amount of dynamic metadata to each captured frame. This includes the requested and actual parameters used for the capture, as well as additional per-frame metadata such as timestamps and statistics generator output.
For most settings, the expectation is that they can be changed every frame, without introducing significant stutter or delay to the output frame stream.

observations.subject: camera subsystem information
observations.object: a static property of the camera subsystem, queryable before configuring output pipelines or submitting requests

observations.subject: the new camera API
observations.object: dynamic metadata to each captured frame, including requested and actual parameters and per-frame timestamps

observations.subject: most settings
observations.object: every frame without significant stutter or delay to the output frame stream

claims.rationale: 三条引文同源（aosp-camera-metadata），分别对应三类。evidence-ec5493ad2bf0 [0,166) 支持 static：'a static property of the camera subsystem... queried before configuring any output pipelines or submitting any requests'（claim 的'描述传感器特性'是'static property of the camera subsystem'在相机元数据语境下的转述，'可查询'部分逐字对应）；evidence-ccd5ac3651b7 [0,255) 支持 dynamic：'dynamic metadata to each captured frame... requested and actual parameters... timestamps'；evidence-5fc4b7551293 [0,152) 支持 control：'can be changed every frame, without introducing significant stutter or delay'（引文以'most settings'指代 control 设置，未逐字出现'control'一词，属上下文映射）。三类别描述均有引文支撑且无冲突。三 target 同源且 provenance 为空，独立性无法举证（independence_unknown）。verdict: supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: A hardware abstraction layer (HAL) is type of abstraction layer with a standard interface for hardware vendors to implement. A HAL allows hardware vendors to implement lower-level, device-specific features without affecting or modifying code in higher-level layers.
HIDL enables communication between HAL clients and HAL services.

observations.subject: A hardware abstraction layer (HAL)
observations.object: an abstraction layer with a standard interface for hardware vendors to implement lower-level device-specific features without affecting higher-level code

observations.subject: HIDL
observations.object: communication between HAL clients and HAL services

claims.rationale: 两条引文同源（aosp-hal-architecture）。evidence-d8e44be806f4 [0,264) 支持 claim 前半：'standard interface for hardware vendors to implement... lower-level, device-specific features without affecting or modifying code in higher-level layers'；evidence-ffb3b59c768e [0,64) 支持 claim 后半：'HIDL enables communication between HAL clients and HAL services.' 两条引文分别覆盖 claim 前后两半，无冲突。两 target 同源且 provenance 为空，独立性无法举证（independence_unknown）。verdict: supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: Most tests in VTS are GTest-style tests that check the HAL implementation.

observations.subject: Most tests in VTS
observations.object: GTest-style tests that check the HAL implementation

claims.rationale: 引文 [0,74)（evidence-21f66837f09c，aosp-vts）：'Most tests in VTS are GTest-style tests that check the HAL implementation.' 与 claim（VTS 中大多数测试是检查 HAL 实现的 GTest 风格测试）逐字对应。verdict: supported。

supporting_quotes.exact: hardware devices are modelled as an oriented graph of building blocks called entities connected through pads.

An entity is a basic media hardware building block. It can correspond to a large variety of logical blocks such as physical hardware devices (CMOS sensor for instance), logical hardware devices (a building block in a System-on-Chip image processing pipeline), DMA channels or physical connectors.

observations.subject: hardware devices
observations.object: an oriented graph of building blocks called entities connected through pads

observations.subject: An entity
observations.object: a basic media hardware building block, corresponding to CMOS sensors, SoC image processing pipeline blocks, DMA channels or physical connectors

claims.rationale: 两条引文同源（kernel-v4l2-mc）。evidence-d3551866bc58 [0,109) 支持'通过 pad 连接的 entity 图'：'hardware devices are modelled as an oriented graph of building blocks called entities connected through pads.'（claim 中括号标注'media controller'为框架名，引文未含该词，但与证据 2 的'media hardware building block'及该源文档主题一致）；evidence-0267a563245f [0,305) 支持'entity 是基本媒体硬件构建块'及可对应对象：'CMOS sensor for instance', 'a building block in a System-on-Chip image processing pipeline', 'DMA channels'。两条引文无冲突。两 target 同源且 provenance 为空，独立性无法举证（independence_unknown）。verdict: supported。
